title: Conductor control for a one-dimensional semilocal domain
statement: Let B be a semilocal (having finitely many maximal ideals) Noetherian domain of Krull dimension 1 [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring], let K be its fraction field, and let B' be the integral closure [def-weil-pbc-integral-closure] of B in K. Then B' is a semilocal Dedekind domain (a Noetherian domain of Krull dimension 1 that is integrally closed in its fraction field [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring]) with fraction field K. If x is a nonzero element of the Jacobson radical (the intersection of all maximal ideals) of B', then for every y in B' there exists an integer n>0 such that x^n y belongs to B.
